memory_update.text: HSTM is the cleanest underfollowed small-cap candidate for the credential_assessment_compliance_layer because it directly maps to healthcare learning, credentialing, provider verification, and compliance record systems.
GHC offers a hidden Kaplan route into test prep, professional licensure, and continuing education, but the exposure must be checked for materiality inside the diversified parent.

FA is a second-order verification gate for education-to-employment outcomes through background screening, education/work verification, credential checks, healthcare credentials, and ongoing compliance monitoring.

Many direct assessment/proctoring assets in this node appear private or foreign-listed, including exam administration, online proctoring, and standardized testing operators; US-listed discovery should therefore include adjacent verification and regulated workforce-compliance vendors.

For later layers, separate direct exam ownership/licensure prep from compliance-record infrastructure and employer verification, because these have different cyclicality, pricing power, and defensibility.

summary: Layer 1B expansion for the underfollowed credentialing / assessment / compliance node found a cleaner small-mid cap lane in healthcare workforce compliance, professional licensure prep, employment/education verification, and career-certification infrastructure. The strongest chokepoint-style candidate is HealthStream because it sits directly in healthcare learning, credentialing, quality/compliance, and provider verification workflows. Graham Holdings is a less obvious mid-cap conglomerate route into Kaplan test prep, professional licensure, and continuing education. First Advantage is a second-order verification gate for workforce outcomes because employer hiring increasingly depends on identity, education, work-history, license, and credential checks. Stride is included as a reference-to-underfollowed hybrid because its public narrative is K-12, but its career-learning and skills-training business may make it a workforce credential pathway beneficiary. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
